base: branche de session (EWC1 et ESN1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Old Castle / Chambre Doree (Explorateurs du Ciel), arrivee sud entre balustrades et colonnes d or, arche nord
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip oldcastlepmd.png passe au generateur ; decor complet et sol complet sans objets edites et recales (0, 0)

reference_da.titre: Old Castle / Chambre Doree (Pokemon Donjon Mystere : Explorateurs du Ciel, oldcastlepmd.png)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Old Castle / Golden Chamber): same golden-beige brick flagstones (#B4A468) with darker aged bronze-gold bricks at the bottom (#8A7846) and bright radiant cream-gold bricks at the top (#EFEFBF), same ornate carved circular sandstone rosette medallion in the center of the floor, same ornate scrolled golden balustrades and golden orb-topped pillars with soft drop shadows, same green-and-silver treasure chests with gold trim. Make a NEW, larger top-down dungeon entrance map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out so the hall feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) on a wide golden-brick walkway flanked by two ornate scrolled golden balustrades and four golden orb-topped pillars (two on the left, two on the right); the walkway opens into a grand golden-brick hall with a large ornate carved circular rosette medallion in the center; on the LEFT and RIGHT flanks of the central medallion (away from the central south-to-north path), two neat curved wings of green-and-silver treasure chests rest on the flagstones, leaving the central south-to-north path completely open and clear of chests; at the NORTH top center, the walkway reaches a grand ornate golden-stone archway / portal framed by two more golden orb pillars, bathed in a bright cream-gold light gradient at the top edge. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.essais: premier essai ; conforme (dalles_claires 3.2, dalles 4.2, bronze 9.5, coffres 8.2)

generation.prompt: Same image, same framing and pixel-art style (1200x896), but remove all 18 green-and-silver treasure chests, all 6 golden orb-topped pillars, both scrolled golden balustrades at the bottom, the golden archway at the top, and their drop shadows, replacing them seamlessly with the surrounding golden-beige brick flagstones; keep the golden-beige brick flagstone floor (from darker bronze bricks at the bottom to bright cream-gold bricks at the top) and the central circular carved rosette medallion at the exact same pixel positions. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

recalage.zones: sol complet : dalles et rosace centrale erodees de 6 px

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne ; seuil 35

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

lueur_portail.origine: halo respirant cree par nous avec uniquement des couleurs exactes du rip oldcastlepmd.png

eclats_or.origine: scintillements crees par nous sur les coffres et spheres d or avec uniquement des couleurs exactes du rip

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors praticable (dalles_claires, dalles, rosace, dalles_sombres)
access.seuil: case 2 x 2 libre dans l ouverture de l arche dorée au nord
